steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Concept: The development gap is the difference in levels of wealth and standard of living between the richest and poorest countries in the world. Reducing this gap requires strategies that address economic, social, and political inequality. | Definition: Investment is when money is put into a country's economy to generate future returns. This can come from foreign direct investment (FDI), governments, or international organisations. | Key Point: Countries typically develop through the Clark-Fisher model: primary sector (farming, mining) → secondary sector (manufacturing) → tertiary sector (services) → quaternary sector (research, IT).
